children: Shares of Dow rose after Bloomberg reported the company is weighing a potential exit from its $20 billion chemicals venture with Saudi Aramco, citing people familiar with the matter.
The stock rose 3.3% to $30.53 in premarket trading on Wednesday. Shares were up 26% year to date at Tuesday's market close.

According to the report, Aramco could potentially acquire Dow's stake in their venture, called Sadara Chemical, to increase its ownership. Dow had a 35% stake in the venture as of last year while Aramco holds the rest.
Dow did not respond to Bloomberg's requests for comment and Aramco declined to comment, according to the report.
